cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Retroactive Permission
cards.instruction: Get approval for something you have already done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll manage dinner tonight. A few guests will be lovely, provided you're with me on it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We only have two chairs. I don't want people standing round my plate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then everyone gets a seat. I'll borrow the chairs and you can choose the table arrangement.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: How many have you asked already?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Six. I've sent the invitations. I'll do the fetching and the washing-up as well; can you give me a yes on the dinner if the seating is yours to settle?
